_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: tag terms and free text are independent predicates. Conversation {{HIT}} (slug {{HIT_SLUG}}), whose message is "searchable kumquat marker", is tagged sf-keep; {{OTHER}}, whose message is "searchable kumquat other", is tagged sf-drop. Conversation rows are ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='<id>']" ("the row of <id>"). To "open the drawer": click the button "Open conversations", then wait until ".drawer" has the class "open" (eval, polled). To "open the search": click the button "Search conversations..." (the search is closed at first), then wait for the editor to be visible. The tag dropdown ("the panel") is data-testid "tag-filter-panel"; "the option T" is [data-testid="tag-filter-option"][data-tag="T"] and its count is its ".tag-filter-option-count". To "open the actions of" a row: hover the row, click the button "Actions" inside it, then wait for data-testid "conversation-actions-menu" to be visible; its items are role menuitem. The search query editor is the contenteditable element with data-testid "conversation-query-editor" ("the editor"); its data-query-value attribute is the serialized query. "The query is X" means data-query-value is exactly X, spaces included. To "set the query to X": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control" (the editor's own select-all), insert_text X (as pasting would), then wait until the query is X. To "clear the query": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control", press Backspace, then wait until the query is "". Query tokens are [data-conversation-query-token="<kind>"] elements inside the editor (kind tag or user); "the token T" is the one whose text contains T. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. "Click the clear button" means click ".drawer-search-clear". 1. Navigate to /c/{{HIT_SLUG}} and wait up to 30s for data-testid "message-input" to be visible. 2. Open the drawer. 3. Open the search. 4. Set the query to "kumquat tag:sf-keep " (text and tag in one query: both must hold). 5. The row of {{HIT}} is visible and the row of {{OTHER}} is not visible (assert_not_visible). 6. Click the clear button, then set the query to "tag:sf-keep kumquat" (order does not matter). 7. The row of {{HIT}} is visible and the row of {{OTHER}} is not visible. 8. Click the clear button, then set the query to "zzz-no-such-conversation-zzz tag:sf-keep ". 9. A search that matches nothing is a search miss, not a filter miss: there is no data-testid "tag-filter-empty", and ".drawer-empty-state" contains the text "No matching conversations". 10. Click the clear button, then set the query to "kumquat marker tag:sf-drop ". 11. A search whose hits the tag then removes is a filter miss: data-testid "tag-filter-empty" is visible. 12. Click data-testid "tag-filter-empty-clear". 13. The query is "kumquat marker " (the free text survives; only the tag terms are dropped). 14. The row of {{HIT}} is visible.
